paragraphs.text:
FUZIRA MARKETPLACE
The market thrives from early morning to after sunset. There 
are hundreds of shops and stalls. Many signs are in English, 
and many British troops idly walk around. You can choose from 
among the following:
• For caravans and travel, go to 384.
• For pottery and artifacts, go to 374.
• For fortune telling, go to 318.
• For an outdoor cafe, go to 340.
• For outfitters and suppliers, go to 383.
• For a dagger-throw game, go to 414.
When you’ve finished at the market, go to any Cairo location 
on the Egypt Location Table.
(Egypt Location)
